title: Fix All Code Review Issues (Phases 2-4)
description: Resolves the 28 remaining code review findings across three priority tiers. Phase 2 (HIGH, 6 fixes) targets correctness bugs and architectural debt in repositories and cubits that ship to users; Phase 3 (MEDIUM, 11 fixes) hardens code smell, design-system compliance, and asymmetric error paths; Phase 4 (LOW, 11 fixes) is lint-level polish. H3 is the keystone: removing the reflection-based endpoint derivation in BaseApiClient unlocks a clean explicit-endpoint API across all API clients, so H3 must land first and is marked blocking.
